from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .models import TelehealthConsultation

@api_view(['POST'])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def broadcast_consultation_note(request, consultation_uuid):

    note_text = request.data.get('clinical_notes')

            'patient_id': consultation.patient_id,
            'clinical_notes': note_text,
            'prescription': prescription
        }
    )

from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .models import TelehealthConsultation

@api_view(['POST'])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def broadcast_consultation_note(request, consultation_uuid):
    consultation = TelehealthConsultation.objects.get(uuid=consultation_uuid, physician=request.user)
    note_text = request.data.get('clinical_notes')
    prescription = request.data.get('prescription')

    # Scope broadcast strictly to the private room channel group for this specific consultation
    channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
    async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
        f"consultation_{consultation_uuid}",
        {
            'type': 'consultation.update',
            'patient_id': consultation.patient_id,
            'clinical_notes': note_text,
            'prescription': prescription
        }
    )
    return Response({'status': 'note_broadcasted'})
